causal_diagnosis: The policy learns to crash quickly because the shaping_reward (-distance_to_pad - vertical_speed) is always negative and dominates the total reward (-138.9 mean). The crash_penalty (-100) is applied on every termination, but since the shaping_reward is already very negative, crashing early yields a higher total reward than surviving longer with accumulating negative shaping. The leg_contact_bonus (+10) is paid every step both legs contact, which can be farmed without completing the task, but the policy still crashes because the negative shaping overwhelms any positive signal. The success_bonus (100) is never achieved because the conditions are too strict and the policy never reaches a state that satisfies them before crashing.
component_interaction_diagnosis: shaping_reward (-distance_to_pad - vertical_speed) is always negative and its magnitude grows with episode length, making longer episodes worse. crash_penalty (-100) is a one-time penalty at termination, but the cumulative shaping_reward over a typical 72-step episode is about -139, which is more negative than the crash_penalty. Therefore, the policy prefers to crash early to minimize the shaping penalty. leg_contact_bonus (+10 per step both legs contact) provides a small positive signal, but it is dwarfed by the negative shaping. The success_bonus (100) is never triggered, so it provides no gradient.
action_coverage_diagnosis: All four discrete actions (0,1,2,3) are used in the final evaluation, with action 2 (main engine) used only 0.8% of the time. The low main engine usage indicates the policy does not attempt controlled descent. Since coverage is already 100%, the bottleneck is not action coverage but trajectory-phase completion. The policy fails to enter Phase 2 (controlled descent) and Phase 3 (touchdown).

The policy reaches the ground but with high speed and off-pad, triggering crash/unsafe. Objective signal alignment: success_bonus never paid.

search_decision.reason: The current reward causes the policy to crash early because the dense negative shaping dominates. We need to: (1) Convert the shaping_reward from always-negative to progress-delta (change in distance and speed) so that making progress yields positive reward and regressing yields negative. (2) Reduce the crash_penalty magnitude to -50 to avoid overwhelming exploration. (3) Make the leg_contact_bonus event-gated (one-time when both legs first contact) to prevent farming. (4) Add a small penalty for high vertical speed when near ground to discourage hard landings. (5) Keep the success_bonus at 100 but relax conditions slightly (allow y<0.2 instead of y<0.1) to make it more reachable. These changes address the scale audit, payment audit, and target behavior gaps.
